title: Hired by Kid Carter's band in Minot, North Dakota
summary: Overstreet in Topeka gets him a telegram offer; he travels to Minot to join Kid Carter's four-piece band playing one-night dances, including reels and square dances.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: Now, what was the first group that you ...(?)..., Foots?
Well, this guy in Topeka named Overstreet...
Overstreet.

Yeah, that was a band in Topeka. So evidently... I often think about it. Evidently, when I went home that summer after I finished school... If I didn't give him my address, evidently he got it from the school. So he sent me a telegram that said he had a job for me out in Minot, North Dakota. I talked it over with my father, and he said yes. So I said, 'Send me a ticket. I'll go.' And he sent me a ticket and I got on a train. It took me about two or three days to get out there. But that was my first band. I was playing...
Overstreet was the guy's name?
Thomas - 33
Overstreet. That was the guy in Topeka who heard of a guy needing a saxophone player out in Minot.
Minot.
Minot, North Dakota. So I went out there. The name of the band was Kid Carter.
Kid who?

Kid Carter. And I can't think of the... I can think of names in the band, but I can only call first names. The guitar player was from Des Moines, and he was called Bill. Now, I don't remember the bass player...
What did you guys do? Did you just play a regular gig, or was it like a one night stand?
It was a four-piece band. Alto, guitar... Oh, C-melody. C-melody, guitar, drum... I don't think we had... No, we didn't have a bass.
Did you have a piano?

Yeah, we had a piano. Piano, drums, guitar and C-melody. And later on, another fellow came from St. Paul, and his name was Art. Barefield told me his name, because Barefield know him. Art. And he played more saxophone than I did. So that's when I cocked my ears. I started picking up on what he was doing, and I started playing the same things. We even played little duets. How we did all that... I guess I faked the harmony. But we'd
Thomas - 34
read off of the piano part and memorize it. But I learned...
What kind of engagement was this?
Well, we played dances.
Was it one-nighters?

One-nighters. And I learned... That's where I learned to play them reels, you know. You had to play them square dances and everything else. That's where I learned how to play "Turkey In The Straw," because I had never played that...
